department: Department of Physics and Engineering Physics

deadline.value: No fixed deadline; applications accepted throughout the year
deadline.quote: Applications are accepted throughout the year.

also.quote: There is no deadline for applications.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Supervisor approval recommended before applying; applications without a confirmed supervisor are circulated to faculty
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval recommended before applying | Before applying, we recommend contacting a potential supervisor whose research areas align with your interests. | if you haven’t yet confirmed a supervisor, it will be shared with our faculty members.

funding.value: PhD students guaranteed a minimum stipend of CAD 20,000/year for 4 years, contingent on meeting standard academic requirements
funding.quote: Ph.D. students enrolled in the Department of Physics and Engineering Physics are guaranteed a minimum stipend of $20,000/year for 4 years. This guaranteed funding is contingent upon the student maintaining standard academic requirements for the Ph.D. program.

entry_route.value: Standard PhD entry requires a master's (70%+); direct entry from a four-year honours bachelor's is available to exceptionally strong students (80%+ in last two years) on department recommendation
entry_route.quote: Master’s degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline | With the recommendation of the unit, direct entry Ph.D. admission is available to exceptionally strong students, who show great promise in terms of academic accomplishments and potential for research. | A cumulative weighted average of at least a 80% (USask grade system equivalent) in the last two years of study

notes: PhD tuition is the same for international and domestic students (CAD 5,637/year in 2026-27). Degrees awarded in Physics or Engineering Physics.
